items.title: 20.2 Benzene se bane compounds ke naam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of naming benzene derivatives (PDF 62-64).

blocks.text: Sirf aik benzene ring wale aromatic hydrocarbons monocyclic aromatic hydrocarbons hain. Benzene ke derivatives ke naam do tareeqon se rakhe jate hain: benzene ko bunyadi naam bana kar, ya khaas naam se.

items: Zyada tar ka naam benzene bunyadi naam aur substituent ko prefix bana kar rakha jata hai, maslan chlorobenzene, nitrobenzene aur methylbenzene.
Kai ke aam naam hain jinhein IUPAC bunyadi naam ke taur par maanta hai, maslan phenol, toluene aur aniline. Akela substituent hamesha C-1 par hota hai, is liye number ki zaroorat nahi.
Kuch ke khaas naam IUPAC mein qubool hain, maslan benzenecarboxylic acid aur benzenesulphonic acid.

blocks.alt: Nau benzene rings, har aik par aik substituent, kitab ke naamon ke saath: toluene (methylbenzene), phenol (benzenol), anisole (methoxybenzene), aniline (benzenamine), benzaldehyde (benzenecarbaldehyde), benzoic acid (benzenecarboxylic acid), benzene sulphonic acid, nitrobenzene aur chlorobenzene.
blocks.caption: Monosubstituted benzenes ke aam naam (kitab ke PDF safha 62-63 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Zyada priority wale substituent ka carbon C-1 hai, aur baqi us se number hote hain. Priority ki tarteeb: -COOH > -CN > -CHO > -COCH3 > -OH > -NH2 > -OR > -R.
Agar dono substituents ki priority barabar ho to alphabet mein pehle aane wala C-1 par hota hai, maslan 1-bromo-2-chlorobenzene.

blocks.alt: Teen disubstituted benzenes, ring ke carbons par number: 3-hydroxybenzoic acid (C-1 par COOH, C-3 par OH; acid ki priority alcohol se zyada), 4-isopropylphenol yani 4-(1-methylethyl)-phenol (C-1 par OH, C-4 par isopropyl; phenol ka alcohol C-1 hai), aur 1-bromo-2-chlorobenzene (C-1 par Br, C-2 par Cl; alphabet mein bromo chloro se pehle).
blocks.caption: Disubstituted benzenes ke naam (kitab ke PDF safha 63 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain? Ortho, meta aur para
blocks.text: Do substituents hon to numbers ki jagah ortho- (o-), meta- (m-) aur para- (p-) use ho sakte hain: ortho yani positions 1,2, meta 1,3 aur para 1,4. Maslan 1,4-dibromobenzene para-dibromobenzene hai.

blocks.alt: Teen dibromobenzenes, ring ke carbons 1 se 6 tak number: C-1 aur C-2 par Br, ortho (1,2); C-1 aur C-3 par Br, meta (1,3); C-1 aur C-4 par Br, para (1,4).
blocks.caption: Benzene ki ortho, meta aur para positions (kitab ke PDF safha 63 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ortho = saath wala carbon (1,2), meta = aik chhor kar (1,3), para = bilkul saamne (1,4). Kitab teesri ring (C-1 aur C-4 par Br) ko 'ortho (1,3)' likhti hai; yeh ghalat hai, sahi para (1,4) hai.
Molecule mein do ya zyada benzene rings wale aromatic hydrocarbons polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons hain, maslan naphthalene (C10H8), anthracene (C14H10) aur phenanthrene (C14H10).

blocks.alt: Naphthalene, do jure rings (C10H8); anthracene, seedhi qatar mein teen rings (C14H10); aur phenanthrene, zaviye par jure teen rings (C14H10), ke Kekule structures.
blocks.caption: Teen polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (kitab ki misalon ke mutabiq asal structures).
blocks.long_description: Polycyclic arenes mein parosi rings aik C-C kinara baant'te hain. Anthracene aur phenanthrene ka formula aik, C14H10, hai lekin un ke rings mukhtalif tareeqe se jure hain: seedhi qatar mein aur zaviye par.

blocks.alt: Chhe arenes, i se vi: (i) benzene jis ke C-1 aur C-3 par NO2; (ii) do parosi carbons par Cl; (iii) OH aur Br aamne saamne; (iv) CH3, us ke saath wale carbon par Cl aur saamne Cl; (v) CH3 aur teen NO2 groups, do parosi aur aik saamne wale carbon par; (vi) benzene par C(=O)-O-CH3.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 20.2 ke arenes (kitab ke PDF safha 64 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Upar bane chhe arenes (Quick Check 20.2) ke naam batayein.

items: Monosubstituted: substituent + benzene, ya qubool naam (toluene, phenol, aniline).
Disubstituted: zyada priority group C-1 par; o (1,2), m (1,3), p (1,4).
